Fiber Surface Extraction generalizes isosurface extraction from univariate scalar fields to bivariate vector fields by extracting the preimage of a curve in the range space [S1].

The claim states that Fiber Surface Extraction generalizes isosurface extraction from univariate scalar fields to bivariate vector fields by extracting the preimage of a curve in the range space. Section 6 extends this to arbitrary curves (polygons/FSCP) by defining the fiber surface as the preimage $f^{-1}(P)$ of a curve $P$ in the range space. The algorithm described (Algorithm 1) adapts Marching Cubes (an isosurface extraction algorithm) to compute this preimage for bivariate vector fields $f$. Thus, every fact in the claim is present in the evidence.
